cases.title: Unusual activity near warehouse equipment
cases.description: Find footage of a person near a forklift. Reconstruct the observable sequence within each recording, and separate what is visible from what cannot be confirmed across clips.
cases.why: Live search on sdg_warehouse_cam-2 returns captions of a person beside a blue forklift, including stationary and moving descriptions. Those captions come from different parent recordings, so they must not be treated as one clock or one identified person.
